title: Add the test script to package.json and document it

brief.goal: Add a "test" script to package.json that runs `node --experimental-strip-types --test test/sum.test.ts`, and add a "## Testing" section to README.md that shows `npm test`. Change nothing else in package.json.
constraints: Change only the files named in the goal; no new dependencies
Keep TypeScript strict; relative imports use explicit .ts extensions
Tests use node:test and node:assert/strict and run with node --experimental-strip-types --test
acceptanceCriteria: package.json name, type and private are unchanged
README.md has a "## Testing" heading followed by the npm test command

files.README.md:
# fixture

A tiny module with a sum function.

expected_files.README.md:
# fixture

A tiny module with a sum function.

## Testing

Run the unit tests with:

```
npm test
```

expected_clean_output: scripts.test added, README Testing section added, nothing else changed.

seeded_defect.description: The script was added under the key "tests" instead of "test", so `npm test` finds nothing.
